name: Scroll Mastery
body:
You are more effective than normal when attempting to activate magic devices and cast spells from scrolls.

Benefit: You gain a +4 bonus on CL and Use Magic Device checks to activate scrolls. You also gain a +4 bonus to Spellcraft checks to record a spell from a scroll into your spellbook.

Advanced Feats: Visions of the Oracle. Author: Sigfried Trent Copyright 2011, Open Design LLC, www.koboldquarterly.com. All rights reserved.
